publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: SpringBoard can intentionally submit black
record.method: Read-only caller trace, surface selection and backing/scanout comparison
record.observation: A captured SpringBoard dimTimerFired call reached LayerKit’s blanking routine before an explicit null-surface, opaque-black presentation. The prior setup pixels remained in backing memory.
record.limits: The trace identifies this QEMU transition. It does not automatically explain every physical flash or prove a backlight power transition.

records.access: Private project record; original material is not distributed

exhibits.title: The null-surface swap is explicit
exhibits.interpretation: Black is the requested output in this capture. The nonzero retained source and explicit null selection distinguish a blank request from destroyed source memory.

exhibits.title: A separate caller trace identifies the request
rows: Last visible → null sequence in this run
exhibits.interpretation: Sequence numbers differ because this is a separate capture. The caller trace identifies the origin of this blank; it does not establish a backlight power change.

exhibits.title: Different bytes remained in the two buffers
exhibits.interpretation: The retained backing digest matches the setup scanout digest recorded in E16. This is a byte-identity comparison, not merely two descriptions of an image.
